what_the_prompt_specifies.text: Detection anchor. The scanner detection timestamp for the event, taken from the canonical spine. Causal and operationally meaningful.
what_the_prompt_specifies.finding: momentum_events_canonical has no timestamp column of any kind. Neither does the underlying momentum_events spine.

evidence.raw_spine_note: `date` and `event_date` are date-only strings. `created_at` is a record-creation field, not a market-time detection stamp. No intraday timestamp exists on the spine.
evidence.d4_note: Every numeric column on the raw spine is D4-quarantined in any case; the point here is only that no TIME column exists, quarantined or otherwise.

A_phase8_reconstructed.definition: first minute_index at which the tick T=0 extended running max reaches 1.30x tick_close_t_minus_1_rth (Phase 8 A10.2)
A_phase8_reconstructed.objection_coverage: 110/114, not 114/114 — escalation row 9 says 'any cohort event'.
A_phase8_reconstructed.objection_grain: This phase measures timescales whose relevant range is seconds-to-minutes. A 1-minute-grain anchor quantizes the detection-to-peak interval — chart 03, the phase's headline number — at exactly the resolution the number lives at.
A_phase8_reconstructed.objection_provenance: It is a re-derivation of what a 30%-from-prev-close screen WOULD have fired at, computed from the tick archive after the fact. It is not the archive's own scanner output. Calling it 'the scanner detection timestamp' would misdescribe it.
A_phase8_reconstructed.objection_circularity: It is derived from the same T=0 tick stream this phase estimates intensity from, and its 1.30x trigger is a price threshold. Detection-to-peak would then be the distance between a price-threshold crossing and an intensity peak computed on the same prints — a defensible quantity, but not the same quantity as 'time from when the scanner told you to when participation peaked'.

B_scanner_hit_catalog.dominant_failure_note: 5,081 of 6,395 catalog records are 'prev_close unavailable — skipped'; 604 carry an empty note and a null timestamp.
B_scanner_hit_catalog.objection: 3 of 114 is not a cohort. Nothing distributional can be computed from it.
